title: Choose a compliant package identity during migration
goal: Replace a legacy-valid restricted package ID, verify the replacement package and migrate direct and dependent consumers without assuming an identity redirect or public feed acceptance.

selectionNotes: Target-11 edition with actual SDK 10.0.402 and 11 RC2 comparison; the exact eight .NET 10 foundations are unchanged.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: Runtime required by the executed net11 consumer; SDK packing/restoring itself is a separate requirement.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: SDK 11 implements the new NuGet behavior; exact verification uses RC2, compared with SDK 10.0.402.

language.name: C#
language.reason: Original current consumer/library uses C# 15; NuGet identity and version selection are language independent.

packageAssets: Original local Bérwyn.Wildlife.Tags and Berwyn.Wildlife.Tags/1.0.0; lib/net10.0 or lib/net11.0/WildlifeTags.dll, separate feeds/caches; Berwyn.Wildlife.Intake/1.0.0 and 2.0.0 dependencies.
platforms: Actual Windows x64 execution; no claim of other OS execution.
prerequisites: Installed SDK/runtime 10 and 11 for the comparison; PowerShell 7 for the local checks.
Separate explicit local sources, cache, CLI home and consumer directories per scenario; disable automatic global-tools PATH integration before first use.
constraints: No public publication, account writes, shared-cache clearing, PATH or persistent environment changes.
Package source policy, actual selected assets and SDK analysis are separate decisions.
Legacy-invalid repeated and mixed dot/dash pairs fail packing on both SDKs; Unicode legacy-valid IDs demonstrate NU5052.
A package rename does not redirect direct or transitive references; deprecation/replacement is a future approved feed action.
stabilityLimitations: Not an experimental API; actual SDK 11 RC2 evidence is not final GA verification. PIN-959/PIN-963 remain open.
